outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured time-lapse images of photoactivation experiments in single cells with no quantification or statistics; it is representative imaging data, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B presents quantitative intensity curves fitted with a diffusion-limited model, and the insets explicitly state that early time-point responses are 'average' values, indicating averaging across multiple measurements/replicates. However, neither the number of replicates (n) nor the type of replicate (e.g., number of cells, independent experiments) is stated anywhere in the caption or panel, so replicate reporting is incomplete.
